test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can do a job alone in 66 days. B can do it alone in 55 days, while A, B and C working together can complete the job in 22 days. In how many days can C do the job alone?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(66, 55, 22) = 330 units.

Efficiency of **A** = 5, **B** = 6, and (**A+B+C**) = 15.

Efficiency of **C** = 15 − (5 + 6) = 4.

Time taken by **C** = 330 ÷ 4 = 82.5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 82.5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Time taken by **A** = 66 days, **B** = 55 days, and **(A + B + C)** = 22 days.

We calculate the **Total Work** as the LCM of the individual number of days.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**
 66
 330 units
 5
 
 

 **B**
 55
 6
 
 

 **A + B + C**
 22
 15
 
 

⇒ Efficiency of **A** = 330 ÷ 66 = 5 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = 330 ÷ 55 = 6 units/day.

⇒ Combined Efficiency of **A, B and C** = 330 ÷ 22 = 15 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = Efficiency(A+B+C) − [Efficiency(A) + Efficiency(B)]

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 15 − (5 + 6) = 15 − 11 = 4 units/day.

⇒ Time taken by **C** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of **C**

⇒ Time taken by **C** = 330 ÷ 4 = 82.5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 82.5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is the amount of work done in one day. Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken.

Time and Efficiency Inverse Rule

Time taken to complete a job is inversely proportional to the efficiency of the person (Time ∝ 1 ÷ Efficiency).

Combined Work Formula

If two people **X** and **Y** can do a job in 'x' and 'y' days respectively, they together complete it in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.</p
